exercises.question: Find the scalar product of vectors A = 3i + 4j and B = 2i + 5j.
exercises.question_amharic: የቬክተሮች A = 3i + 4j እና B = 2i + 5j ስኬላር ብዜት (dot product) ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Multiply i components: 3 * 2 = 6.\n2. Multiply j components: 4 * 5 = 20.\n3. Sum the components: 6 + 20 = 26.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Multiply i components: 3 * 2 = 6.\n2. Multiply j components: 4 * 5 = 20.\n3. Sum the components: 6 + 20 = 26.
exercises.formula_or_working: A · B = A_x B_x + A_y B_y.
